mapper.select: SELECT graph_id, atlas_id, name, parent_graph_id, content::text AS content, rev, node_count, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM struct_mind_graph WHERE graph_id = #{graphId}
SELECT graph_id, atlas_id, name, parent_graph_id, content::text AS content, rev, node_count, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM struct_mind_graph WHERE graph_id = #{graphId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT graph_id, atlas_id, name, parent_graph_id, rev, node_count, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM struct_mind_graph WHERE atlas_id = #{atlasId} AND deleted = 0
AND name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT graph_id, atlas_id, name, parent_graph_id, content::text AS content, rev, node_count, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM struct_mind_graph WHERE atlas_id = #{atlasId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT graph_id, parent_graph_id FROM struct_mind_graph WHERE atlas_id = #{atlasId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO struct_mind_graph ( graph_id, atlas_id, name, parent_graph_id, content, rev, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{graphId}, #{atlasId}, #{name}, #{parentGraphId}, CAST(#{content, typeHandler=com.flydeer.repository.postgres.typehandler.JsonbStringTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{rev}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
